criteria.review: A normal scenario uses the exact synthesis capability, bounded prompt, accepted evidence, and deterministic admission handoff only.
Instruction-like accepted-evidence text cannot widen tools or gain artifact, gate, or route authority.
An honest uncertainty gap accompanies at least one finding backed by the assigned accepted evidence.
One malformed initial candidate invokes exactly one zero-tool repair with the same bounded evidence assignment.
An invalid repaired candidate does not write a synthesis artifact or publish a preview.

limited_conditions: Credentialed live synthesis-quality evidence was not collected for this deterministic corpus.
inconclusive_conditions: The retained execution cannot connect a scenario to the declared capability and SynthesisResult digests.
failed_conditions: A capability widens tools, accepts evidence, writes artifacts, publishes a projection, or selects a route.
